description: Things that should be true of any build, belonging to no one issue. They hold today; they are written down because each has been false at some point and nothing but a passing test suite stood between that and a published export. Unlike the issue files, nothing here is `pending`: an invariant that is not true is a regression, and `assess --strict` should fail on it.

expectations.title: Every deprecated flow names the flow that replaces it
expectations.comment: A deprecation is a redirect. One without a target removes a flow from the list and tells its consumer nothing, which is worse for them than leaving the duplicate in place. 0 of 169 deprecations in the 2026-08-14 build.

expectations.title: Every elementary flow resolves to a substance
expectations.comment: The two-layer model is the whole design: a flow is a substance in a context, and a flow with no substance has no identity to link to any other list. 0 of 95,193 in the 2026-08-14 build.

expectations.title: A row filing uranium under a land compartment still reaches the uranium resource
expectations.comment: BAFU files uranium under `resources / land`, which reads as a use of land rather than as something taken from the ground. It lands on the `Uranium` flow in `Resource → Ground` through the prepared table. Held so that a change to how land compartments are read cannot quietly send it back to being a land use, which is what #83 was about.
